subject: Working with Onfido, Veriff & others
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Onfido, Veriff & iProov, helping to support real-time verification of their multimodal model outputs, so thought it might be interesting to explore if we can help at ID R&D in a similar way.

The common headache these teams faced was the classic build-vs-buy dilemma - with exploding maintenance and development costs for their internal platforms creating a bottleneck for scaling to new markets & supporting multimodal HITL reviews.

At Encord we've built a multimodal data platform, designed to support real-time analysis & validation of Documents, Video & Audio, enabling ID verification teams to scale their HITL operations whilst maintaining a robust QA audit trail. We support cloud-based, VPC, and on-premise deployments, providing the flexibility to meet a wide range of infrastructure needs. 

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Onfido, Veriff & iProov and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?

text:

schedule (assuming interest).
